glosses: In practice; in effect or in actuality, though possibly not officially, technically, or legally.

examples.text: Stalin was not technically or legally the head of state but was practically so.

glosses: Almost completely; almost entirely.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: effectively, nearly, virtually
